name: Saimin, Suki Desu ka?  ~Ano Ko no Hatsujou Switch ON!~
original_name: 催眠、好きですか？ ～あの娘の発情スイッチON!～
source:
The main character is a very well known otaku in his school.
He watches one of "Hypnosis in heat" series at home. He loves this series which stars Mr. Zow who hypnotizes a girl on the street and makes her a porn actress.
But this time, the show seems to be a bit different.

With the video, he gains a strong hypnotic power and starts to control women around him!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE064322.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角是学校里非常有名的御宅族。
他在家观看《热火催眠》系列之一。他喜欢这部由Zow先生主演的连续剧，他在街上催眠了一个女孩，让她成为了色情女演员。
但这一次，节目似乎有些不同。

通过视频，他获得了强大的催眠力量，开始控制身边的女人！
